name: Eisa Internet North
summary: First and biggest ISP in Far North Queensland (~4500+ clients; POPs Cairns, Mossman, Innisfail, Atherton); an Eisa-branded operation; defunct.

events.details: Eisa Limited entered voluntary administration 21 Sep 2000; regional ISP businesses including Internet North (NQ, ~4,500 subs) sold to Austar United Broadband Pty Ltd under Sale and Purchase Agreement 05 Oct 2000 approved 06 Oct 2000 (NSWSC 940); delisted 2001.

refs.label: NSWSC 940: Eisa administration and sale to Austar (06 Oct 2000)
Delisted: EISA Limited — administrator 21 Sep 2000, sale to Austar 06 Oct 2000
